news.title: Despair over future fuels political anxiety for Michigan college students
news.summary_en: Many young people feel uncertain about their paths and pessimistic about American government. Their anxiety is fueling restlessness in national politics that has contributed to the rise of outsider candidates.
news.author: The Associated Press

news.title: Albion, Cooley, Madonna, 6 others on watch lists as financial woes mount
news.summary_en: An expert said appearing on the watch lists could be “a warning sign” of trouble ahead.
news.author: Kim Kozlowski
